items.quote: And Moses went out of the city from Pharaoh, and spread abroad his hands unto the LORD: and the thunders and hail ceased, and the rain was not poured upon the earth.
items.claim: Moses went out of the city and spread his hands toward the LORD, whereupon the thunder, hail, and rain ceased.
items.action: went out of the city, spread abroad his hands
items.mechanism: spreading of hands toward the LORD
